subject.title: [Feature]: Continue upstream trace context for Gateway WebSocket requests

question: Should OpenClaw standardize authenticated per-request `traceparent` propagation as part of the public Gateway WebSocket protocol?
rationale: This adds a durable protocol and generated-client surface; code review can assess safety, but maintainers must choose whether this observability capability belongs in the stable Gateway contract.

options.title: Sponsor the request-frame contract
options.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical implementation, requiring the stated authentication, fallback, isolation, and generated-client guarantees.

options.title: Defer protocol propagation
options.body: Decline or narrow the feature if observability context should remain outside the Gateway protocol for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the request-frame contract
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical implementation, requiring the stated authentication, fallback, isolation, and generated-client guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available contact for the linked implementation and its intended contract; a Gateway protocol owner should make the final product decision.
